source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: InAppNotificationEvent extends MouseEvent and stores notificationId. The close button supplies dataset.id, the container propagates its data-id to that button, and the manager listens in capture mode and dismisses only event.button === 0. Keep this event contract when refactoring close handling. The focused browser test checks the emitted ID and constructor name; it uses a synthesized click and does not prove all keyboard activation paths.
title: Carry notification identity in the close event and preserve mouse data
